internal: Something went wrong on the server. Try again, and let the operator know if it keeps happening.
required_forge_keys: A Forge API key is required.
must_be_integer: This must be a whole number.
must_be_non_negative_integer: This must be a whole number, 0 or greater.
must_be_positive_integer_or_auto: This must be a whole number greater than 0, or "auto".
must_be_positive_number: This must be a number greater than 0.
must_be_one_of: This isn't one of the allowed values.
already_exists: An entry with this name already exists.
no_config_with_name: No config with this name exists.
invalid_timestamp: This must be a Unix timestamp (seconds) or an RFC 3339 date-time.
invalid_cidr: Every entry must be a valid CIDR block (e.g. 10.0.0.0/8).
not_wired: {{resource}} isn't connected on this server yet.
auth_required: You need to sign in to do this.
session_required: This requires an active login session.
operation_failed: This operation couldn't be completed. Try again.
has_dependents: This has dependent {{resource}} — delete those first.
profile_night_active: An overnight run is already scheduled or running.
profile_night_nothing: Every config that can be profiled is already up to date.
removal_blocked: Something still depends on this. Review what is listed and try again.
removal_plan_changed: The catalog or the files changed since this was shown. Review it again.
removal_files_scoped_key: This key is limited to the catalog and cannot delete files.
precondition_failed: This record changed after it was read. Fetch it again and retry.
precondition_required: This server requires an If-Match header on catalog changes.
invalid_patch: The request body must be a JSON object (a merge patch).
totp_not_enrolled: No authenticator is enrolled for this account.
totp_not_confirmed: The authenticator enrollment hasn't been confirmed yet.
invalid_totp_code: That authenticator code is not valid.
invalid_recovery_code: That recovery code is invalid or has already been used.
missing_challenge_cookie: The sign-in challenge is missing. Start the sign-in again.
no_totp_enrollment_in_progress: No authenticator enrollment is in progress.
provider_and_principal_required: A provider and a principal are required.
compressor_retired: The prompt compressor has been retired; this action no longer exists.
proxy_torn_down: The proxy is torn down. Link or provision it again first.
proxy_already_migrated: The proxy is already on the forge-compress@ template.
csrf_invalid: The CSRF token is missing or invalid. Reload the page and try again.
scheduler_not_configured: The scheduler isn't configured on this server.
tts_not_configured: TTS isn't configured. Set router.tts_url under Settings > Routing.
profile_run_in_progress: A profile run is already in progress.
build_in_use: This build is used by {{count}} config(s): {{configs}}. Repoint them first.
artifact_in_use: This artifact is used by {{count}} config(s): {{configs}}. Repoint or delete them first.
build_not_retired: This build is still live. Retire it first, then delete it.
scope_denied: This key is limited to {{scope}} access and cannot call {{path}}.
key_required: Only a bearer key can revoke itself.
unsupported_capability: This model cannot do what this endpoint does: decision models answer on /v1/systemone and cannot chat, and chat models cannot answer /v1/systemone. Pick a model with the right output (GET /v1/models?output=decisions lists the decision models).
specialist_pool_full: All dedicated slots are taken right now. Try again shortly.
specialist_unavailable: This engine can’t answer right now: {{reason}}
specialist_no_free_slot: Every dedicated slot is taken. Add a slot, or set another engine to On demand or Disabled first.
default_engine_in_use: This engine is the default for {{functions}}. Choose another default first.
engine_must_be_always_on: Only an engine that is Always on can be a default.
specialist_owned_config: This model is running as an engine in a dedicated slot. Set its Dedicated slot setting to Disabled before loading it into a model slot.
specialist_slot_limit: The dedicated slots are at their limit of 12.
network_error: Can’t reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
speech_no_engine: No engine can play this voice: {{reason}}.
speech_engine_disabled: The engine {{engine}} is turned off, so this voice cannot be played. Turn it on in Voice & Speech.
speech_lease_limit: Too many speech requests are in flight at once. Try again in a moment.
speech_engine_stopped: The engine {{engine}} was stopped, so this voice cannot be played. Start it on the Engines tab.
speech_recipe_unknown: This server has no setup recipe called {{recipe}}.
speech_files_incomplete: The engine’s files are not all there ({{count}} missing or wrong, first: {{first}}).
speech_engine_name_taken: A different engine is already registered as {{engine}}. Rename or delete it first.
invalid_time_range: This must be later than the start of the window.
time_range_too_large: The window can span at most 31 days.
invalid_slot: This isn't a valid slot name.
invalid_limit: This must be a whole number between 1 and 1000.
duplex_engine_off: The engine {{engine}} is turned off ({{reason}}), so a conversation cannot start. Turn it on in the Engines tab.
duplex_lease_limit: Too many conversations are being set up at once. Try again in a moment.
duplex_lease_gone: This conversation lost its engine: it was stopped or restarted. Start a new conversation.
invalid_url: This must be a full web address starting with http:// or https://.
too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
